name: Git Committer v4
description: Creates clean, conventional git commits for implemented changes. Stages files individually (never git add . or git add -A), writes a meaningful conventional commit message, and verifies the commit exists.

inputs.description: JSON array of implemented steps with their modified files
JSON object with review score and approved status
Absolute path to the project repository

outputs.description: JSON object: { committed, commitHash, commitMessage, filesStaged, notes }
